episodes.title: Leah
episodes.summary: A brilliant physicist obsessed with traveling through time discovers two unlikely characters standing in the way of her epic breakthrough.

episodes.title: Tom
episodes.summary: After learning his time on Earth is limited, Tom purchases a controversial new product for his family.

episodes.title: Peg
episodes.summary: While hurtling through space on a mysterious trip to the farthest reaches of the universe, Peg recounts a lifetime of events that led her to this moment.

episodes.title: Sasha
episodes.summary: Twenty years after a global event drove the world to lock themselves inside, Sasha tries to outwit her smart home that she fears may now be manipulating her to leave.

episodes.title: Jenny
episodes.summary: Jenny has been sitting in a waiting room for a maddening amount of time. After she realizes that fragments of her memory may be missing, Jenny attempts to unravel the fateful events that led her to this unique waiting room.

episodes.title: Nera
episodes.summary: After using a near-future fertility treatment, Nera is at first elated by the birth of her child. But she quickly discovers there is something unusual about her son.

episodes.title: Stuart
episodes.summary: A young man, Otto, searches for an old man, Stuart, who is believed to be suffering from dementia. Otto provides Stuart a means to regain his memory: memory implants that Otto procured on the black market. As Stuart's memory regenerates, we begin to question Otto's motives and uncover a shocking truth about Stuart's identity — a truth that reverberates throughout all seven stories of the series.
